title: GCS quick prep + action plan for AE 1:1 — Northbeam
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Carlos Mendez (AE) — prep for Northbeam renewal window (90d out)
Date/time: 2026-03-13 weekly sync cadence
Goals for this 1:1: clarify renewal signals, align on next quarter expansion targets, remove product blocker, agree outreach cadence for executives.

Context snapshot:
- Account: Northbeam (mid-market analytics SaaS) — current ARR: $210k ARR, on Dedicated plan, high ingestion volume spikes (weekend batch jobs).
- Renewal window: 2026-06-10 (est).
- Usage: embeddings calls up 28% MoM; token spend concentrated in inference-heavy reranking route.
- CS health score: 62 (reduced from 78 after two recent infra incidents).
- Open items: support-442 (KV cache eviction causing 502s on long seqs), feature-request-88 (custom batching policy), onboarding docs gap for new data schema.

Key ask for Carlos (AE):
- Confirm exec intro cadence (target VP of Data by end-April) — we want sponsor visibility pre-renewal.
- Share any contract flexibility constraints (discount thresholds, procurement lead times).
- Surface any upsell threads (security audit request from GRC) — opportunity to push Private deployment pitch.

Talking points / playbook structure (short bullets I can use):
- Acknowledge incidents -> remediation steps (SRE ticket and SLA timeline) -> demonstrate reduced recurrence risk (can share short-term mitigation & long-term roadmap).
- Focus on cost predictability: propose dedicated reserved baseline + burst buffer; show model-level cost delta with Optimize suggestions.
- Executive hook: 30-min technical due diligence + business ROI summary (swap technical jargon for impact metrics).
- Objection scripts: latency > show perf chart, security concerns > show KMS/HSM + audit log timeline, cost pushback > phased reserved commit + usage cap.

Questions to surface in meeting:
- Has procurement provided timeline/budget windows? If not, can Carlos push check-in with finance contact?
- Which feature requests are blocking their adoption or confidence? Prioritize FR-88 vs onboarding docs.
- Is VP of Data more sensitive to latency or model correctness metrics?

Coaching notes to self (how to frame asks to AE):
- Use data not promises: cite specific token spend and incident counts.
- Keep ask binary: either schedule exec intro this month OR commit to a joint remediation demo next week.
- Push for a shared success metric (reduce error surface by 70% pre-renewal).

Proposed next steps (action items):
- Sophie: draft executive one-pager (ROI + remediation timeline) and send to Carlos for review — due 2026-03-16.
- Carlos Mendez: confirm VP of Data availability and procurement windows; intro email if OK — due 2026-03-20.
- Priya Nair (SRE liaison): triage support-442 root cause & propose hotfix plan; status update by 2026-03-15.
- Product PM (linked): evaluate FR-88 triage priority and tentative delivery quarter; ping @product-hosted-api — due 2026-03-18.
- CS playbook task: prepare a 20-min joint demo script showing KV cache mitigation + cost controls — assign to Sophie/Carlos — dry run 2026-03-22.

Notes to self / scratch thoughts:
- If procurement timeline slips past May, consider interim 3-month bridge contract with higher price but guaranteed priority SLA.
- Might run small eval with Private sandbox for security team to lower friction — need legal approval cost estimate.
- Keep record of every executive touchpoint in the shared Confluence page (linked above) — helps renewal narrative.

Risks / escalations to flag if not resolved by next sync:
- Continued 5xx spike during long-sequence jobs -> could trigger churn conversations.
- Billing surprise due to unbounded reranking calls -> finance escalates.

Slack quick lines I might use in the call if things get tense:
- "Totally hear the frustration; here's what we fixed already and what we will do next week — you shouldn’t see a repeat of last week’s outage."
- "If it helps, we can commit to a joint exec Q/A with our infra lead and your VP of Data to align on risk tolerance."

Follow-ups to log after the 1:1 (placeholders):
- exec intro status (Y/N + contact info)
- agreed demo date/time
- updated remediation JIRA links
- contract/discount guardrails

End of prep. Keep this doc editable — will copy core bullets into Confluence page and the meeting notes template after sync.

Quick tags for copy/paste: Northbeam, renewal-90d, incident-KV-cache, private-deploy-pitch, exec-intro
